name: Kokuritsu Otoko no Ko Bokujou ~Otoko no Ko-tachi no Seieki wa Mitsu no Aji
original_name: 国立男の娘牧場 ～男の娘たちの精液は蜜の味～
source:
The year is 2020.
Three years ago the "Otoko No Ko Law" was enacted.
Crossdressers are raised and sold like produce......

Specifically, their semen has wonderful properties.
Milking crossdressers for their white nectar is like printing money.
The world found out and started a whole agricultural business. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166512.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
2020年。

三年前，“男娘法”颁布。变装者像农产品一样被饲养、出售……

具体来说，他们的精液拥有奇妙性质。挤取变装者的白色甘露，就像印钞票一样。世界得知这一点后，建立起完整农业产业。
